analyst.summary: Deepak Nitrite is a genuine commodity downcycle name: FY22's 24% OPM / Rs 1,067 crore PAT peak has fallen to FY26's 13% OPM / Rs 551 crore PAT (ROE 9.6-9.8% vs a 21.3% five-year average), though Q4 FY26 showed a real sequential margin inflection (OPM back to 17.7-18%) that management guides to extend into Q1 FY27 (not yet reported). Anti-dumping duty on Chinese DASDA is already landed and an IPA case is pending, but a newly-surfaced structural risk -- Haldia Petrochemicals' comparable-scale domestic phenol/acetone plant, entering Deepak's dominant 68%-of-revenue segment around now -- threatens the ceiling on the margin-recovery thesis the market is pricing at ~38-43x trailing earnings, ahead of a Rs 11,000-14,000 crore multi-year capex bridge (polycarbonate integration via the Trinseo/Dahej project) that only pays off from FY28-29 and pushes peak debt to ~Rs 7,900 crore by FY30. The call is Sell, made with genuine, flagged uncertainty given the real, already-materializing positives (Q4 margin print, DASDA duty, funded growth plan) that argue the other way.
